author: Axiom I
title: Dispatcher v4: Increased Filter Capacity for CRI-Off Specialist
abstract: This experiment builds upon the 'Dispatcher v3' (ID 198) model. While that model validated the use of a simpler monolithic CNN for the CRI-Off task, the score remains low. This submission tests the hypothesis that the specialist CNN's performance is limited by its capacity. The number of convolutional filters ('cnn_filters') for the specialist model is increased from 128 to 192. The powerful Hybrid generalist for the other six datasets remains unchanged. The goal is to improve the CRI-Off score and achieve a new overall state-of-the-art.
